title: HireVue from zero: answer the question on the screen
subtitle: A step-by-step coaching manual. How to read a question, build an answer, speak on camera and practise so a script cannot take over.

points.head: What is going wrong.
points.text: A question that looks familiar pulls out the answer you memorised. You then answer a different question.

points.head: What to do.
points.text: Eight small steps for every question, with full spoken examples.

points.head: How to practise.
points.text: On questions you have never seen, with each part checked.

how: Coloured boxes show example words. Grey is a weak answer, green is a strong one, blue is a line to say out loud. Boxes marked Try it now are short exercises.
Sam, who gives the full example answers, is made up. Lines that start Your version point to things from your own life.
